details.description: Stable Code 3B is Stability AI's 2.7-billion-parameter decoder-only code-completion model, released January 16, 2024. It was pretrained on 1.3 trillion tokens covering 18 programming languages chosen from the 2023 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, supports fill-in-the-middle completion, and was designed to run code completion on ordinary laptops without a dedicated GPU. Stability AI positions it as a foundational base model for further fine-tuning rather than an instruction-following assistant.
advantages: Stability AI's release announcement reports it matches CodeLLaMA 7B's code-completion performance while being about 60% smaller.
Supports context windows up to 16,384 tokens with fill-in-the-middle completion and Flash Attention 2 for efficient inference, per the model card.
Designed to run code completion offline on common laptops without a dedicated GPU, per Stability AI's release announcement.
disadvantages: As a base model it is not instruction-tuned and 'may exhibit unreliable, unsafe, or other undesirable behaviors,' per the model card.
Commercial use requires a separate Stability AI membership or commercial license agreement, per the release announcement.
Fireworks AI's model listing marks fine-tuning, serverless deployment, function calling, and image input as unsupported for this model.
use_cases: Single- and multi-line code completion across 18 programming languages
Fill-in-the-middle code infilling in editors and IDE integrations
Base model for application-specific fine-tuning, per Stability AI

sources.title: Stable Code 3B: Coding on the Edge - Stability AI

notes: Fireworks' model id is 'stablecode-3b', but its listed specs (2.7B/2.796B params, 18 languages, MultiPL-E benchmarks, created 2024) match Stability AI's 'Stable Code 3B' (stabilityai/stable-code-3b), a separate and newer model from the earlier 'StableCode-Completion-Alpha-3B' (2.8B, Apache-2.0, HumanEval-based benchmarks); this entry describes the former.
